description: This Java interface defines a repository for accessing DashboardInfo entities in a SQL database, including various query methods for retrieving dashboards based on tenant, customer, edge, image link, and resource link criteria.

classes.name: DashboardInfoRepository
classes.description: Spring Data JPA repository interface for DashboardInfoEntity with custom query methods.

methods.name: findFirstByTenantIdAndTitle
methods.description: Finds the first DashboardInfoEntity matching tenant ID and title.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a page of DashboardInfoEntity objects for a tenant, optionally filtered by search text.

methods.name: findMobileByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards visible on mobile for a tenant, optionally filtered by search text.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds dashboards associated with a customer within a tenant, optionally filtered by search text.

methods.name: findMobileByTenantIdAndCustomerId
methods.description: Finds mobile-visible dashboards associated with a customer within a tenant, optionally filtered by search text.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEdgeId
methods.description: Finds dashboards associated with an edge within a tenant, optionally filtered by search text.

methods.name: findTitleByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Retrieves the title of a dashboard by tenant ID and dashboard ID.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds dashboards by tenant ID and image link with a limit.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds dashboards by image link with a limit.

methods.name: findDashboardInfosByTenantIdAndResourceLink
methods.description: Finds dashboard info objects by tenant ID and resource link with pagination.

methods.name: findDashboardInfosByResourceLink
methods.description: Finds dashboard info objects by resource link with pagination.

methods.name: findByIdIn
methods.description: Finds dashboards by a list of IDs.
